dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature (falcate) measured from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated ratio of 1.4:1 base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curvature forming a broad, rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick-set beak extension with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single elliptical white patch or depigmented lesion visible on the mid-posterior region of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark dorsal cape with a sharp contrast boundary against the lighter lateral and ventral surfaces; prominent ventral-lateral pectoral fin.
